dedupe_keys.name: uk household appliance energy occupancy and gaf images 2022

description: This dataset records appliance electricity consumption and indoor context in one Leicester household during April–November 2022. The research team combined smart-plug measurements, temperature, relative humidity and occupancy sensors through a local edge-computing system. The deposit also includes outdoor weather from MET Norway. Mendeley version 2 lists CSV time series and compressed Gramian Angular Field image collections, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0; the article cites version 1. Electrical variables include power, voltage and current, with binary occupancy and weather fields providing context. Coverage is limited to one household, and the inspected metadata do not establish a common sampling interval across all channels. The image transforms normalize values and should not be mistaken for additional independent measurements. A reviewer-assessed use is checking appliance-demand or occupancy components of building-energy simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk provides a related multi-home collection, while model-energyplus offers building simulation. No files were fetched and neither relation was numerically tested.
name: UK household appliance energy, occupancy and GAF images, 2022
